arithmetic: decimal.Decimal end to end; source literals recovered as text via ast.get_source_segment and witnesses parsed with parse_float=Decimal, so no float64 exists on the comparison path
description: Python consumers that transcribe values out of a convention-C or muon-pinned witness they read but do not write. Such a consumer is a deliberate control arm: it reproduces a published record at that frame, so a qou-q0zk drain that repoints its input breaks a working cross-check. The control arm is a CONSUMER, not a witness, so no witness-level classification can see it.
how_to_use: Before draining a qou-q0zk candidate, check whether any consumer here reads it. A CONTROL-ARM edge is a stop: leave the artifact where it is. Everything else still needs the ordinary per-file verdict -- this audit narrows the drain, it does not clear it.
known_blind_spots: a control arm that reads its reference value at run time instead of transcribing it (PR #5616 made this change to published_q0 in the known positive itself)
control arms outside Python (TypeScript, Lean, shell)
witness names resolved by basename; duplicated stems (bean qou-kcii) are flagged via name_ambiguous but not adjudicated
a stale-frame witness serialising neither fingerprint is not in the candidate set at all
